Rezide frontend (rezide.in v2) · Complete project QA, functionality & security audit

Not Ready for Production

Tested 25 November 2026 · branch development @ 1298ca2 · live backend (same as rezide.in)

A SummaryB StatisticsC ModulesD BugsE SecurityF PerformanceG UI/UXH APII EvidenceJ RecommendationsK Verdict

A. Executive summary

Rezide is a Next.js 16 / React 19 real-estate site (projects, properties, Find Realtor, compare, list-property, customer account and realtor dashboard) that proxies the rezide.in backend through 31 same-origin API routes. This audit ran the production build of development in an isolated checkout against the live backend and drove it with real Chrome and Edge, alongside automated gates, an API test suite, safe security probes and four code-review passes.

25
Page routes tested (of 46)
127
Page loads across 4 browser setups
30
User journeys / features
31
API endpoints tested (76 cases + 11 probes)
173
Internal links crawled (0 broken)
45
Issues found (+4 info)
Overall health: Not Ready for Production. Public browsing is solid — every public page renders on desktop, tablet and mobile in Chrome and Edge with no script errors, no broken images, no sideways scrolling and no broken links, and the API validates input well. But there is an account-data leak (QA-01), the branch cannot be built as committed (QA-02), sign-in is client-side only (QA-03), the realtor dashboard has no backend (QA-04/05) and map-view filters don't work (QA-06).

D. Complete bug report (49)

QA-01CriticalAnyone can read any user's viewed, shortlisted and shared listingsAccount / Security · Confirmed (live)
Module / page
Account / Security · /api/account/activity
Feature
Account activity API
Priority / severity
Critical / Blocker
Testing status
Confirmed (live)
Description
The route takes userId and phone from the query string, checks only their format and calls the backend with the server's service secret. No session is required. On module/projects the route was deliberately disabled for this reason; the development merge re-enabled it.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign out.
  2. Open /api/account/activity?tab=viewed&userId=<any 24-hex id>.
  3. Open /api/account/activity?tab=shared&userId=<id>&phone=<a user's mobile>.
Expected
401 Unauthorized unless the request carries a verified session for that user.
Actual
HTTP 200 with the activity list (QA used a made-up id and phone only, so the list was empty).
Evidence
api-results: GET …tab=viewed&userId=000…000 → 200 (42 ms); tab=shared … → 200. Code: src/app/api/account/activity/route.ts:12-25.
Likely root cause
Identity is taken from the request instead of a server-verified session.
Recommended fix
Derive the user from an HttpOnly session cookie/token validated on the server; return 401 otherwise. Until then, disable the route as module/projects did.

QA-03HighSign-in state is an editable browser record; role and expiry are set by the clientAuth / Security · Confirmed (code)
Module / page
Auth / Security · /dashboard/**, /account
Feature
Session & access control
Priority / severity
High / Major
Testing status
Confirmed (code)
Description
The session (user id, role, expiry) lives in localStorage and is not backed by a server token or cookie. The role comes from the tab the user picked on /login, not from the backend. /dashboard/** is gated only by session.user.role in the browser. There is no middleware.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as a customer.
  2. Edit the rezide-demo-session localStorage entry: role "realtor", far-future expiresAt.
  3. Reload /dashboard.
Expected
Role and access decided by the server.
Actual
The realtor dashboard UI opens; combined with QA-01 any user id can be used.
Evidence
src/stores/session.ts:31-65,108; src/services/auth.ts:95-106,160; dashboard-shell.tsx:191; no src/middleware.ts or proxy.ts.
Likely root cause
Authentication was built client-side ahead of a backend session.
Recommended fix
Have the backend issue an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session; read role/expiry from it; verify it in route handlers and a proxy.ts.
QA-04HighRealtor dashboard calls backend endpoints that do not exist, and sends no user identityRealtor dashboard · Confirmed (live)
Module / page
Realtor dashboard · /dashboard/contacts, /groups, /teams, /credits, /firm, /profile
Feature
Realtor dashboard data
Priority / severity
High / Major
Testing status
Confirmed (live)
Description
Every dashboard page reads /dashboard/* on the backend. Those routes answer with the backend's generic “Not found - /v1/admin/…” (the same response as a made-up path). Requests also carry no token or cookie, so the backend could not scope them to a firm.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as a realtor.
  2. Open /dashboard/contacts, /dashboard/teams, /dashboard/credits.
Expected
Real firm data.
Actual
Error states; writes fail with a toast. (Signed-in run BLOCKED: no test account — confirmed by probing the endpoints.)
Evidence
Backend GET /dashboard/contacts|groups|team|credits|firm|profile → 404 “Not found - /v1/admin/dashboard/…”; GET /qa-nonexistent-zzz returns the same message. Code: services/dashboard.ts:270-382; client.ts:46.
Likely root cause
Frontend built against a proposed contract (docs/API.md) the backend has not implemented.
Recommended fix
Hide the realtor dashboard from UAT until the API exists, or agree the contract with the backend team.

QA-06HighMap view ignores BHK, search text and other filtersProperties · Confirmed (live)
Module / page
Properties · /properties?view=map
Feature
Map view list
Priority / severity
High / Major
Testing status
Confirmed (live)
Description
In map view the list is built only from the spatial service (type, intent, budget). matchesProperty is never applied, so BHK, locality, project, search text and drawer filters are ignored while the filter badge still counts them.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Open /properties?city=Mumbai&view=map.
  2. Add the 3 BHK filter, or search “Lodha”.
Expected
Only matching listings.
Actual
Same 93 listings with no filter, with 3 BHK and with “Lodha” (identical BHK mix 1/1.5/2/3).
Evidence
GET /api/properties?…&view=map&bbox=…&mapZoom=14 → total 93 in all three cases. Code: services/properties.ts:343-360 (commit 07eb6d2).
Likely root cause
Regression in 07eb6d2 “map view issues fixed”.
Recommended fix
Apply matchesProperty(p, criteria) to the resolved records or forward the filters to the spatial API.

QA-08HighOne visitor can block every enquiry form for everyone for 10 minutesLeads / Security · Confirmed (live)
Module / page
Leads / Security · /api/*/enquiry, /api/realtors/contact, /api/list-property/enquiry
Feature
Lead rate limiting
Priority / severity
High / Major
Testing status
Confirmed (live)
Description
Unless LEAD_TRUST_PROXY=true, all clients share one bucket of 5 enquiries per 10 minutes (invalid ones count too). The counter is per server process.
Steps to reproduce
  1. Send 5 invalid enquiries (e.g. empty bodies) to any lead endpoint.
  2. Submit a valid List Property form from another device.
Expected
Limits apply per client.
Actual
HTTP 429 “Too many enquiries” for everyone.
Evidence
During this audit 5 invalid probes exhausted the bucket: the next POST /api/list-property/enquiry and /api/realtors/contact returned 429. Code: lib/api/lead-guard.ts:14-16.
Likely root cause
Client IP is only trusted when LEAD_TRUST_PROXY is set; otherwise key = "shared".
Recommended fix
Set LEAD_TRUST_PROXY=true behind the proxy, key by real client IP in a shared store (Redis), count only valid submissions, add a CAPTCHA.

E. Security audit

IDIssuePriorityStatusRemediation
QA-01Anyone can read any user's viewed, shortlisted and shared listingsCriticalConfirmed (live)Derive the user from an HttpOnly session cookie/token validated on the server; return 401 otherwise. Until then, disable the route as module/projects did.
QA-03Sign-in state is an editable browser record; role and expiry are set by the clientHighConfirmed (code)Have the backend issue an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session; read role/expiry from it; verify it in route handlers and a proxy.ts.
QA-07Realtor sign-up form dead-ends after the user fills it inHighConfirmed (code)Show the notice up front or route to the Realtor Corner trial.
QA-08One visitor can block every enquiry form for everyone for 10 minutesHighConfirmed (live)Set LEAD_TRUST_PROXY=true behind the proxy, key by real client IP in a shared store (Redis), count only valid submissions, add a CAPTCHA.
QA-10Sign-in popup accepts 5-digit numbers, rejects formatted numbers and blocks 6–7 character passwordsMediumConfirmed (live)Require 10 digits, strip +91/spaces, use min 6 (or raise sign-up to 8) everywhere.
QA-12No forgot / reset password optionMediumConfirmed (live)Add the flow, or link to OTP sign-in.
QA-14Realtors signing in through the popup become “seekers”MediumConfirmed (code)Use the backend user's role.
QA-15A failed sign-up after OTP verification strands the userMediumConfirmed (code)On signin_required go to /login; otherwise return to the details step.
QA-21Backend admin API and uploaded files are served from the site's own domainMediumConfirmed (live)Remove it or restrict to needed paths; add nosniff, Content-Disposition: attachment and a sandbox CSP for /v1/admin/file/**.

Recommendations

  • Project detail is the slowest page (6.0 s desktop, 776 KB JS, 105 requests): lazy-load the gallery, maps and plans below the fold.
  • Project search, Location tab and Firm page transfer 1.6–1.8 MB, mostly images (≈1 MB): serve responsive sizes (next/image sizes), WebP/AVIF, lazy-load below the fold.
  • Layout shift: firm page CLS 0.62 and agent profile 0.26 (QA-34); reserve space for logos and banners.
  • Ready to move home has the highest LCP on desktop (3.5 s): preload the hero image or use a smaller one.
  • Filters facets (2.5 s) and /api/projects without a city (2.1 s): cache per city.
  • Realtor Corner pulls 1.4 MB of JS from the broker site and took 20 s on the tablet run (QA-36).

J. Prioritised recommendations

  1. QA-01 Close the account activity leak (disable the route or require a server session).
  2. QA-02 / QA-46 Merge module/projects into development (Next 16.4.6 and the pending fixes), then rebuild.
  3. QA-03 Agree a real backend session (HttpOnly cookie) and enforce it in route handlers and a proxy.
  4. QA-04 / QA-05 / QA-28 Keep the realtor dashboard out of UAT until its API exists; remove demo/sample copy.
  5. QA-06 Apply filters to the map-view list.
  6. QA-08 Set LEAD_TRUST_PROXY and per-client limits before opening lead forms to testers.
  7. QA-07, QA-13, QA-30 Hide or fix realtor sign-up, callback/trial and generic enquiry until their endpoints exist.
  8. QA-09 – QA-12, QA-14 – QA-18 Fix the user-facing Medium issues (city switch, sign-in rules, deep links, forgot password, ₹0).
  9. QA-21, QA-22 Harden the /v1/admin rewrite and the next= redirect.
  10. QA-27 Make lint and tests green so CI can gate releases.
  11. Then the Low items and the performance work in section F; finally run the blocked tests with test accounts on the UAT URL.

K. Final verdict

Not Ready for Production. The public, read-only experience is close to ready. Two Critical issues — a data-exposure API (QA-01) and a branch that cannot be built (QA-02) — and several High issues (client-only sessions, a realtor dashboard with no backend, broken map filters, a dead-end realtor sign-up, a lead limiter one person can exhaust) must be fixed first. Signed-in flows also need to be re-tested with test accounts on the deployed UAT URL before a production decision.

Method: isolated checkout of development @ 1298ca2 (Next 16.4.6 applied locally only to be able to run it), production build on localhost against the live backend; Chrome 1440×900 / 820×1180 / 390×844 and Edge 1440×900 via Playwright with a fresh profile; GET requests and deliberately invalid submissions only; no records created or changed. Findings marked “Confirmed (code)” come from code review and were checked against the source; “Potential risk” items need a runtime check.
